license_required.quote: No person shall practice or hold himself or herself out as being able to practice music therapy or provide music therapy services in this state unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of the Music Therapy Practice Act.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen (18) years of age

moral_character_required.quote: Is in good standing based on a review of the applicant's music therapy licensure history in other jurisdictions, including a review of any alleged misconduct or neglect in the practice of music therapy on the part of the applicant

degree_required.value: bachelor's degree or higher in music therapy, or its equivalent, from a program approved by the American Music Therapy Association or any successor organization within an accredited college or university
degree_required.quote: Holds a bachelor's degree or higher in music therapy, or its equivalent, from a program approved by the American Music Therapy Association or any successor organization within an accredited college or university

accrediting_body.quote: from a program approved by the American Music Therapy Association or any successor organization within an accredited college or university

degree_level.quote: Holds a bachelor's degree or higher in music therapy, or its equivalent

credential_pegged.quote: Passed the examination for board certification offered by the Certification Board for Music Therapists or any successor organization or provides proof of being transitioned into board certification, and the applicant is currently a board-certified music therapist.

required.quote: Successfully completed a minimum of one thousand two hundred (1,200) hours of clinical training, with at least fifteen percent (15%) or one hundred eighty (180) hours in preinternship experiences, and at least seventy-five percent (75%) or nine hundred (900) hours in internship experiences.

experience_source.quote: Successfully completed a minimum of one thousand two hundred (1,200) hours of clinical training, with at least fifteen percent (15%) or one hundred eighty (180) hours in preinternship experiences, and at least seventy-five percent (75%) or nine hundred (900) hours in internship experiences.

duration.value: 1,200 hours (at least 180 hours preinternship, at least 900 hours internship)
duration.quote: a minimum of one thousand two hundred (1,200) hours of clinical training, with at least fifteen percent (15%) or one hundred eighty (180) hours in preinternship experiences, and at least seventy-five percent (75%) or nine hundred (900) hours in internship experiences

Internship programs may be approved by an academic institution, the American Music Therapy Association, or both

exams.name: Examination for board certification offered by the Certification Board for Music Therapists
exams.notes: Applicant must be currently a board-certified music therapist. Exam requirement was waived until January 1, 2020 for applicants designated as RMT, CMT, or ACMT in good standing with the National Music Therapy Registry.
exams.quote: Passed the examination for board certification offered by the Certification Board for Music Therapists or any successor organization or provides proof of being transitioned into board certification, and the applicant is currently a board-certified music therapist.

interval_years.quote: Every license issued under the Music Therapy Practice Act shall be renewed biennially.

required.quote: Proof of maintenance of the applicant's status as a board-certified music therapist shall also be required for license renewal.

available.quote: The Board shall issue a music therapy license to an applicant when such applicant has completed and submitted an application upon a form and in such manner as the Board prescribes, accompanied by applicable fees, and evidence satisfactory to the Board that the applicant is licensed and in good standing as a music therapist in another jurisdiction where the qualifications required are equal to or greater than those required in this act at the date of application.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed and in good standing as a music therapist in another jurisdiction where the qualifications required are equal to or greater than those required in Oklahoma.
requirements.quote: the applicant is licensed and in good standing as a music therapist in another jurisdiction where the qualifications required are equal to or greater than those required in this act at the date of application

exists.quote: There is hereby established the Music Therapy Committee to advise the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision on all matters pertaining to the licensure, education and continuing education of licensed music therapists and the practice of music therapy.

authority.value: Advises the Board on all matters pertaining to licensure, education and continuing education; facilitates development of public education materials; facilitates information dissemination; assists and advises in disciplinary hearings; provides analysis of disciplinary actions at least once per year.
authority.quote: The Committee shall have the power and duty to: ... Advise the Board on all matters pertaining to the licensure, education and continuing education requirements for and practice of music therapy in this state

national_certification.quote: Passed the examination for board certification offered by the Certification Board for Music Therapists or any successor organization

national_association.quote: from a program approved by the American Music Therapy Association or any successor organization within an accredited college or university

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice or hold himself or herself out as being able to practice music therapy or provide music therapy services in this state unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of the Music Therapy Practice Act.

credential_type.quote: the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision shall issue a license to an applicant for a music therapy license

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or hold himself or herself out as being able to practice music therapy or provide music therapy services in this state unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of the Music Therapy Practice Act.

title_protection.quote: A person or business entity, its employees, agents or representatives shall not use in conjunction with that person's name or the activity of the business the words licensed music therapist, music therapy, music therapist, the letters MT or MT-BC, or any other words, abbreviations or insignia indicating or implying directly or indirectly that music therapy is provided or supplied

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice or hold himself or herself out as being able to practice music therapy or provide music therapy services in this state unless the person is licensed in accordance with the provisions of the Music Therapy Practice Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Treated or attempted to treat ailments or conditions other than by music therapy as authorized.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Treated or attempted to treat ailments or other health conditions of human beings other than by music therapy as authorized by the Music Therapy Practice Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to refer patients to other health care providers when music therapy treatment is inadvisable or outside scope.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to refer patients to other health care providers if symptoms are known to be present for which music therapy treatment is inadvisable or if symptoms indicate conditions for which treatment is outside the scope of music therapy practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used drugs, narcotics, medication or intoxicating liquors to an extent affecting professional competency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Used drugs, narcotics, medication or intoxicating liquors to an extent which affects the professional competency of the applicant or licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony crime substantially related to music therapy and posing a reasonable threat to public safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted of a felony crime that substantially relates to the occupation of music therapy and poses a reasonable threat to public safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain a license as a music therapist by fraud or deception.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtained or attempted to obtain a license as a music therapist by fraud or deception

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been grossly negligent in the practice of music therapy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been grossly negligent in the practice of music therapy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court and not subsequently declared sane.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been adjudged mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction and has not subsequently been lawfully declared sane

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of conduct unbecoming a licensed music therapist or detrimental to the public or profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been guilty of conduct unbecoming a person licensed as a music therapist or guilty of conduct detrimental to the best interests of the public or the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of any act in conflict with the ethics of the profession of music therapy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been guilty of any act in conflict with the ethics of the profession of music therapy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license suspended or revoked in another state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Had a license suspended or revoked in another state.

definition_quote.value: the clinical and evidence-based use of music interventions to accomplish individualized goals for people of all ages and ability levels within a therapeutic relationship between a patient and a practitioner who is licensed pursuant to the Music Therapy Practice Act
definition_quote.quote: "Music therapy" means the clinical and evidence-based use of music interventions to accomplish individualized goals for people of all ages and ability levels within a therapeutic relationship between a patient and a practitioner who is licensed pursuant to the Music Therapy Practice Act

methods_authorized.quote: The music therapy interventions may include music improvisation, receptive music listening, song writing, lyric discussion, music and imagery, singing, music performance, learning through music, music combined with other arts, music-assisted relaxation, music-based patient education, electronic music technology, adapted music intervention and movement to music.

national_certification_body.quote: who holds current board certification from the Certification Board for Music Therapists

credential_required_for_licensure.quote: Passed the examination for board certification offered by the Certification Board for Music Therapists or any successor organization or provides proof of being transitioned into board certification, and the applicant is currently a board-certified music therapist.

certification_maintenance_required_for_r.quote: Proof of maintenance of the applicant's status as a board-certified music therapist shall also be required for license renewal.

protected_titles.quote: shall not use in conjunction with that person's name or the activity of the business the words licensed music therapist, music therapy, music therapist, the letters MT or MT-BC, or any other words, abbreviations or insignia indicating or implying directly or indirectly that music therapy is provided or supplied

advisory_body_composition.value: Five members: three licensed music therapists (initially actively practicing music therapy for at least three years), one licensed health care provider who is not a music therapist, and one lay person.
advisory_body_composition.quote: three members shall, upon initial appointment, be qualified persons who have been actively practicing music therapy in this state for at least three (3) years; provided, their successors shall be licensed music therapists, b. one member shall be a licensed health care provider who is not a music therapist, and c. one member shall be a lay person.

advisory_body_name.quote: There is hereby established the Music Therapy Committee to advise the State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision

value: diagnosis or assessment of any physical, mental or communication disorder
music_therapy_excluded_from_scope.quote: The practice of music therapy does not include the diagnosis or assessment of any physical, mental or communication disorder.

authorized_music_therapy_interventions.quote: The music therapy interventions may include music improvisation, receptive music listening, song writing, lyric discussion, music and imagery, singing, music performance, learning through music, music combined with other arts, music-assisted relaxation, music-based patient education, electronic music technology, adapted music intervention and movement to music.

treatment_planning_required.quote: developing an individualized music therapy treatment plan for the client that is based upon the results of the music therapy assessment. The music therapy treatment plan includes individualized goals and objectives that focus on the assessed needs and strengths of the client

interdisciplinary_collaboration_required.quote: the licensee collaborates, as applicable, with the primary care provider(s) to review the client's diagnosis, treatment needs and treatment plan. During the provision of music therapy services to a client the licensee collaborates, as applicable, with the client's treatment team

referral_acceptance_authorized.quote: accepting referrals for music therapy services from medical, developmental, mental health or education professionals, family members, clients, caregivers or others involved and authorized with provision of client services.

least_restrictive_environment_required.quote: minimizing any barriers to ensure that the client receives music therapy services in the least restrictive environment

delegation_of_services_restricted.quote: No person shall coerce a licensed music therapist into compromising client safety by requiring the licensed therapist to delegate activities or tasks if the licensed music therapist determines that it is inappropriate to do so.

student_exemption_from_licensure.quote: Any person enrolled in a course of study leading to a degree in music therapy from performing music therapy services incidental to the person's coursework when supervised by a licensed professional, if the person is designated by a title which clearly indicates the person's status as a student

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Upon written request of a licensee, the Board may place an active license on an inactive status subject to an inactive status license fee established by the Board.
